# C07 — Conditions of Worldhood

## #0

A world becomes inhabitable through the conditions that let something appear, matter and admit a response. Language, memory, bodily capacity, tools, rules and other participants do more than supply contents for a finished world-picture. They condition what can be distinguished and which actions are possible from here.

[World-Picture / World-Atlas](C37-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) distinguishes represented relations from their constituting worldhood: a picture selects relations within a world; an atlas coordinates pictures and their transformations. Worldhood includes the conditions under which either can be made, encountered and used.

## #1

The explanatory direction reverses. An agent models its world; the context-world also constitutes this agent's capacity to model anything. Change the memory available, the language in use, the permitted instruments or the interlocutor, and the question itself can acquire different terms. The world is active within the standpoint from which it is represented.

[Objective Internality](../A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) is **notational, nomological and exclusion-constituted**. Marks make relations articulable; rules constrain what can follow; exclusions make this actual determination emerge against alternatives. The three operations together constitute a field from which an agent can distinguish, judge and act. A visible output alone does not disclose the world from which it became possible.

## #2

The distinction between internal and external is relative to an operation. A permission imposed by another institution can nevertheless be constitutive of what an agent can do. A remembered encounter is internal to a later decision while carrying a history that the deciding agent did not author. The field's interior is not bounded by the skin of a device or the location of a memory store.

[Objective Internality](C41-Objective-Internality.md) includes the language, memory, tools, permissions and histories through which this context-world becomes available. A [Context Frame](C08-Context-Context-Frame.md) holds a bounded selection of those conditions together so that a particular inquiry can proceed and its means become inspectable. Neither the frame nor its inventory exhausts the conditions of worldhood. What a frame leaves outside can remain materially consequential within it.

## #3

Worldhood has both a present configuration and a formed history. A map of currently possible transitions answers one question; the actual passage by which this configuration arose answers another. The sequence can change the field of possibilities, and that changed field conditions the next sequence.

In [[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics|Symbolon Dynamics]], synchronic configuration and diachronic trajectory make the two temporal readings exact. The configuration discloses which transitions are possible now; the trajectory retains the passage through which those possibilities took form. A phase-space models configurations and trajectories; it does not replace the world whose activity it models. An image can transform its interpreter; mathematical dynamics follows a specified system; a computational state records a particular configuration of an executed process. Their comparison preserves these different objects of inquiry.

## #4

Another locally grounded world can affect the conditions from which this one next acts. That is stronger than adding another opinion to a store. A contribution can alter what counts as evidence, which distinction is available, or whether a route of action remains legitimate. It must also remain answerable to the source-world from which it came.

[Objective Co-Internality](../A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) relates participants who remain locally grounded while their contributions can change one another’s conditions. Shared grammar lets their worlds meet while their distinct source-relations, permissions and powers of refusal remain effective.

Through [Diaphaneity](C09-Diaphaneity.md), the resulting account discloses the position, means and conditions through which it was produced. A changed source, permission or standpoint can become readable in what appears and consequential for the next judgment. Making an output observable and exposing the worldhood of its production are different achievements.

## #5→0

An account enters [the conditions of further process](../../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/process.md) when it changes what can subsequently appear, matter or be acted upon. [Bergson’s melody](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/bergson/bergson-1913-time-free-will-pogson/bergson-1913-time-free-will-pogson.md#bergson-1913-time-free-will-pogson-q001) supplies a precise qualitative comparison: the arriving note reorganises the heard whole, so the return concerns changed significance as well as an added item. His [clock analysis](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/bergson/bergson-1913-time-free-will-pogson/bergson-1913-time-free-will-pogson.md#bergson-1913-time-free-will-pogson-q002) differentiates counted positions from the conscious synthesis retaining a succession. [Whitehead’s satisfaction and objectification](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/whitehead/whitehead-1978-process-reality/whitehead-1978-process-reality.md#whitehead-1978-process-reality-q002) distinguish the occasion’s own becoming from its functioning in another’s formation; [objective immortality](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/whitehead/whitehead-1978-process-reality/whitehead-1978-process-reality.md#whitehead-1978-process-reality-q003) names its achieved availability beyond individual absoluteness. [The distinct duration and concrescence histories](../../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/process-systems-science/DEVELOPMENT-process-systems-science.md) keep these objects of process available together.

The native constituting relation makes the changed inheritance consequential. A corrected source can change what an earlier argument now means; a retained memory or altered permission can change which comparison or action is possible next. Recording these changes gives an inspectable chronology. Following how they reorganise reference, salience and access makes their work within worldhood readable. Within a local comparison the agent is the functional knower, its retained sources and comparison rule are means, and the inherited claim and returned text are known. The corrected source becomes a genuine reference for the next act when it enters the means that act actually uses. [Objective Internality](C41-Objective-Internality.md) preserves the recursive offices: in a person’s containing inquiry the comparing agent and its record are themselves means; inspecting that agent makes it known in a further act. Life / Mind holds these relations while Subjective Immediacy names the knower condition of their appearing. The return changes the constituted field from which another determination can arise.

[Bohm’s enfoldment comparison](../../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/bohm.md) makes a form’s dependence on its field concrete. The Peat interview’s distributed dye and holographic information distinguish concealed organisation from absence; the postmodern-science essay gives enfolding and unfolding priority in Bohm’s proposed interpretation. The native constituting relation concerns what can appear, matter and be acted upon, beyond the resulting picture. The comparison keeps each source’s scope: a region is not an exhaustively readable copy of the universe, and a physical illustration does not establish the full ontological claim.

An achieved account can change attention, action or infrastructure and thereby enter the conditions of later accounts. Return is causal as well as interpretive: what was produced becomes part of what can next produce a difference. Within [[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD|Encounter / Region / Name / Count / Countenance / Account]], a region holds the conditions through which someone or something can appear, be named and admit a response. Naming makes an achieved distinction addressable; counting retains its criterion; countenance lets the counted participant answer. The account returns these determinations to another encounter whose participants can correct how they are named, counted or received.

[World-Picture to World-Atlas](../A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) keeps coordinating views answerable to the worldhood that makes their differences consequential. Within the [Order of Dependence](../A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md), an inspectable context-world belongs to the mediating field through which an agent acts. Increasing its inspectability clarifies the means of world-disclosure rather than turning worldhood into a completed inventory.
